title: Railroaded (film)

text.lead: Railroaded is a lost 1923 American silent drama film directed by Edmund Mortimer and starring Herbert Rawlinson, Esther Ralston and David Torrence.
text.plot: In England Richard Ragland, the son of a prominent judge, is sent to prison on false evidence. After escaping he changes his name and vows vengeance on the man who put him there.
text.cast:
- Herbert Rawlinson as Richard Ragland
- Esther Ralston as Joan Dunster
- Alfred Fisher as Hugh Dunster
- David Torrence as Judge Garbin
- Lionel Belmore as Foster
- Mike Donlin as Corton
- Herbert Fortier as Bishop Selby
